term: can be an external fact-unifier in every possible world
resolution: Step6 admits a de-re globally-capable-candidate restriction and a distributive world-local restriction. Preserve them as sibling interpretations, not equivalent statements. Step5 worldwise existential unifiers do not provide a globally capable candidate. Neither parse licenses silently exchanging worldwise existentials for one rigid mind or one common source of all facts. Can-role and actual exercise, as well as world scope of mind, remain independently open.
